text:
zoe (Product Designer): quick design review — Create API Key modal: when orgs have many roles the picker overflows and chips compress into a scrollbar; some users assume roles attach to their user.

cal (PM): saw a support ticket about this. small clarifier under the picker: 'These roles apply to this API key' should reduce confusion. :white_check_mark:

ryan (Frontend): repro'd keyboard trap: arrow nav in the virtualized list can trap focus. chips also lack an obvious keyboard remove target (backspace only atm).

meera (A11y): NVDA / VoiceOver notes: chips read as plain text. need an aria-live polite region announcing 'N roles selected' on change, remove buttons labelled 'Remove role <name>', and ensure the Show/Hide secret toggle has an accessible name + aria-pressed.

zoe (Product Designer): design idea: show up to 4 pills inline then a '+N' overflow button that opens a compact dialog with the full role list + checkboxes. add the one-line clarifier near the picker: 'These roles are granted to this API key.' Keeps the main flow tidy.

cal (PM): when wildcard/admin scopes are selected we should surface a stronger inline banner (icon + orange tint). Suggested short copy: 'Warning: This key grants broad access (admin.*). Use only for trusted services.' add a tiny disclosure 'why' that reveals one-line rationale instead of linking out.

ryan (Frontend): implementation notes: condensed pills are CSS; the '+N' must be a real button that opens a role=dialog with a focus trap. i'll move arrow-key handlers to the list container to avoid traps and add labelled remove buttons for keyboard users. telemetry: create_modal_open, create_submit, overflow_open, warning_ack.

meera (A11y): prefer a custom disclosure (manage aria-expanded) so announcements are predictable. ensure the dialog receives focus and announces its title. contrast check: orange bg + small caption may fail AA — increase weight or darken text.

zoe (Product Designer): empty state copy proposal: 'You don't have any API keys yet — create one to get started' with a helper line: 'Assign minimal roles. Rotate keys regularly.'

cal (PM): action items:
1) ryan: implement condensed pills + overflow dialog + keyboard fixes + telemetry (PR with tests)
2) meera: draft accessible copy & a11y checklist, run screen-reader pass
3) zoe: update mocks and microcopy variants
4) cal: telemetry spec and support note updates

ci-bot: build queued for branch 'fix/keypicker-compact' — running unit + accessibility checks. link: https://ci.internal/reports/1201

meera (A11y): i'll triage any a11y failures from CI and iterate on PR comments. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
